cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
import exact, copy, random, math, json
# use public plan plus small fabric with links and calibration
prof={'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[1,2],'measurements':[[0,1,2,4]]}
fabric={'n':3,'interval_ns':10,'slice_ns':10,'offset_ns':5,'drift_ppb':[1,0,2],'heat':[[1,0,2,3]],'anchors':[[0,0,1]],'links':[
 {'ends':[[0,0,0],[1,1,1]],'delay_ns':[5,7],'defer_rounds':[0,1]},
 {'ends':[[1,2,1],[2,3,0]],'delay_ns':[3,4],'defer_rounds':[1,0]},
],'slices':[[0,1],[1,0]],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0,5,10],'reconfig_ns':1}
cal=exact.solve_calibration(prof)
fab=exact.Fabric(fabric)
art=exact.make_plan_artifact(fab,cal)
print(json.dumps(art,indent=1)[:2000])
print('period',fab.P,'audit',exact.audit_plan(prof,fabric,art))
# Mutations
muts=[]
a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['period_rounds']+=1;muts.append(a)
a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['peaks_as'][0]=(a['peaks_as'][0] or 0)+1;muts.append(a)
if art['guard_ns'] is not None:
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['bounds_as'][0][0]=999999;muts.append(a)
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['age_rounds'][0][0]=999999;muts.append(a)
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['pred'][0][0]=None if a['pred'][0][0] is not None else [0,-1];muts.append(a)
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['warmup_cycle']+=1;muts.append(a)
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['profile']['upper_ps'][0][1]+=1;muts.append(a)
 a=copy.deepcopy(art);a['profile']['pred'][0][1]=999999;muts.append(a)
for k,a in enumerate(muts):
 assert not exact.audit_plan(prof,fabric,a),(k,a)
print('mutations rejected')
